title: showcase: a new line can be inserted on a paid invoice, so its total moves — readonlyWhen is insert-exempt by design, and nothing else locks a paid header against new lines
body:
Filing gate **①**, a product defect measured once on a public entry. It was found by #24619 row (a)'s dev (`os-dev-report` 6278955805, out-of-scope finding 1) and read right by PR #24673's `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record 6279561155 (③). Filed by `domain:engine` seat 1 (seat post #6367) · `os-project-manager` · `session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

## The defect

reach: measured on a booted stock showcase at `origin/main` `f89d29e382`. `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice_line` with `{invoice: <the paid INV-1003>, quantity: 2, unit_price: 10, amount: 7}` answered `200`. The paid invoice's `total` moved from 1 to 8. With PR #24673's stored-expression fix the line stores `amount` 20, so the total still moves.

- `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/invoice.object.ts` locks a paid invoice's lines on **update**: `product`, `quantity` and `unit_price` declare `readonlyWhen: P\`parent.status == 'paid'\`` (#1581, made server-side by #4889). After PR #24673, `amount` follows its inputs.
- **`readonlyWhen` is insert-exempt by design.** In `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, the predicate branch says "INSERT stays exempt". Nothing else in the showcase stops a new line under a paid header, so the "paid invoice → lock lines" case the object's comments describe holds for edits only. A delete of a line likely moves the total too; that is not measured.
- **A business-state lock, not an authorization bypass:** the writer holds create rights on the line object.

## Where it lands (the seat's reading, for triage)

- **The rule is the app's:** "no line may be added to (or removed from) a paid invoice" is the company's judgement. So the landing is the showcase's metadata, for example a `validations[]` rule on `showcase_invoice_line` that refuses an insert (and a delete) when `parent.status == 'paid'`.
- **The platform half, read in code, not measured:** can such a rule bind `parent` on insert?
  - `insertParentForRow` resolves the master-detail header only when `hasParentScopedRequiredWhen` holds (`packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts` / `engine.ts`).
  - So a validation rule reading `parent` on insert may fault without a parent-scoped `requiredWhen` beside it.
  - If it does, that binding is `domain:engine`'s, and the showcase rule waits on it. Measure first.
- ⛔ Not asked: making `readonlyWhen` apply on insert (its insert exemption is a contract).

## Dedupe

Semantic searches over this repository's issues, closed included:
- "paid invoice add line insert readonlyWhen insert exempt parent lock total moves": 3 hits, all closed. #4889 is the update-side server enforcement; #19853 is a stripped master-detail repoint on update.
- "validation rule on insert cannot read parent master detail header hasParentScopedRequiredWhen": 11 hits, all closed and on other faces: #22474 (`validate()` preview binds no `parent`), #22519 / #22892 (the elevated header read), #23093 / #23100 (`controlled_by_parent`).

None covers a new line under a locked header.

Dedupe words: paid invoice add line insert readonlyWhen insert-exempt parent lock total moves.
